breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to set the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface. The ground truth corrected this by removing that erroneous instruction. The generated specification explicitly identified the instruction as incorrect ('the premise that it vanishes is incorrect and is therefore disregarded') and proceeded to define the calculations using the non-zero torsional shear stress, which aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
